rules.rationale: Small heterocycles maximize polar surface area per atom, the dominant hydration driver.
Large halogenated solutes have low polar surface area and poor water packing.
Aromatic surfaces hydrate poorly, so aromaticity should lower hydration affinity.
Ring-free acyclic scaffolds pack well in water, raising hydration affinity.
